# hiok_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

A managed Kubernetes cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Optional

- `node_count` (Number) Worker nodes.
- `node_cpus` (Number) vCPU per node.
- `node_memory_mb` (Number) Memory per node, in MiB.
- `region` (String)
- `resource_group_id` (String) Resource group the resource is placed in.
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the resource is billed to.
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version. Defaults to the region's current.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
